messages:
Maria (PM): quick sync — we need a decision on prioritization: SOC2 gating Dedicated launch vs. landing two customer-facing features this quarter. RICE numbers updated in the doc.
Alex (Eng): saw the doc. RICE for the two features: Feature A score 42, Feature B 28. SOC2 items eq to ~60 effort points to finish the remaining controls.
Maria (PM): thanks. impact vs effort feels close. Feature A is high-impact for PLG adoption; SOC2 buys enterprise deals. both are revenue-critical but different timelines.
Chen (Security): current SOC2 gaps: centralized audit logs, KMS integration for at-rest keys, evidence for change control. None of these are trivial — each needs code + infra + attestations.
Sam (Sales): we have 3 prospects asking for SOC2 before contract. If we delay, likely loses deals. But Feature A will increase expansion with self-serve customers.
Alex (Eng): rough idea: deliver minimal SOC2 scope for Hosted (not Private) in 6w with a focused sprint: KMS + logging pipeline + docs. full Dedicated/Private readiness is longer.
Maria (PM): proposal: 1) prioritize minimal SOC2 must-haves so we can close enterprise deals (partial gating), 2) ship Feature A to hosted customers only behind an entitlement flag, 3) delay Feature B until next quarter.
Chen (Security): minimal SOC2 path OK if we can commit to evidence collection. We need infra tickets and a small audit-runbook. Also mitigations for Private deployments (we still need customer-specific controls).
Alex (Eng): that maps to lower dev effort than full SOC2. I'll RICE-adjust the tickets: SOC2-minimal becomes medium effort (33), Feature A behind flag becomes low eff (12). Sequencing: SOC2-minimal first, Feature A sprint 2.
Maria (PM): sounds reasonable — can we get risk acceptance from security for feature-flagged Feature A on hosted without full SOC2? @Chen
Chen (Security): yes, with controls: scoped dataflow, feature-flag audit trails, and a documented rollback plan. We'll require a short security review before launch.
Sam (Sales): can we promise onboarding to those 3 prospects on hosted + SOC2-minimal timeline? they'll accept hosted if we provide SOC2 evidence and entitlement terms.
Maria (PM): decision: go SOC2-minimal (priority 1), ship Feature A to hosted with flag (priority 2), postpone Feature B (priority 3). Action items:
- Alex: create sprint tickets + updated RICE scores (due EOD)
- Chen: produce SOC2-minimal runbook & review checklist (due in 3 business days)
- Sam: align with customers on hosted + entitlement approach (pause any promises on Private until we have full controls)
sec-bot: Reminder: security-request-123 assigned to Chen; due in 3 days. :bell:
Alex (Eng): ok I'll update tickets. if we hit blocker on KMS we fallback to customer-specific encryption configs but that's heavier.
Maria (PM): we'll reconvene Thu sync if anything slips. thanks everyone :thumbsup!
thread_summary: Prioritization debate: choose minimal SOC2 path to unlock enterprise deals while shipping high-impact hosted feature behind a flag. Action items and owners assigned.
